hour_convention.note: Annual statistics: every hour is matched within its own period (settled node and hub on the same local label; a run bus and the run hub on the same study-day hour index). No value here depends on the hour-of-day clock.
hour_convention.settled: settled: local prevailing time (America/New_York), hour beginning; the spring-forward day holds 23 labels and the autumn fold is collapsed to one label, so a whole year reads 8,759 hours. HE = label + 1.
hour_convention.solved: runs: flat calendar, no daylight saving (standard time), hour index 0–23 per study day, hour beginning. HE = index + 1.

method.association: retired from bars (D-008): association rows overlap and cannot be stacked
method.bridge: Each bar has `key` (one per monitored facility: settled DA and RT share it through the ISO-NE name grammar) and `legend_key` (bars with equal legend_key may share a legend entry). `match` is the settled ↔ run bridge: approximate = an ISO-NE interface code and a PROBE flowgate with the same name (definition unconfirmed — show "≈"); exact = a line whose station/kV text and SF fingerprint both agree (BERLIN 1771 ↔ BERLIN CT–SOUTHINGTN-1 115 only); none = a separate legend entry either side of the divider. Never imply continuity by colour across it otherwise.
method.exact: exact: the run's own DFAX of the unit at the bus's PCR price node to each binding constraint (uni.fact_pcr_cong_impact); the stored MCC is −Σ μ·DFAX, so on the settled sign each constraint's share is mean(μ·DFAX) and the shares sum to the MCC (identity to 1e-6). Contingencies are summed per monitored facility; no regression gate, band 0; bars under 0.01 $/MWh go to Other.

gates.fixed: these are defaults the API applies to every period; a request may tighten min_hours, never loosen any gate
gates.merge: contingency variants of one monitored facility are summed into one column before fitting

method.not_attributable: not_attributable: the period fails a location gate (R² < 0.95, no facility >= 50 h with VIF <= 10, or κ > 30). Only the total (net_mcc) is drawn, with the reason; no bars, no Other.
method.recovered: recovered: the location's hourly congestion component (settled sign) regressed on every binding constraint's hourly shadow price, least squares with an intercept, one fit per period (calendar year or run; never pooled). Contingency variants of one monitored facility are merged into one bar (their contributions summed). Bar = recovered shift factor × mean shadow price over every hour, $/MWh of the annual mean MCC. Gated (method.gates): location R² >= 0.95; facility >= 50 binding hours; VIF <= 10 on the merged design; κ <= 30; |bar| >= 0.01; |SF| <= 1. Each bar carries a ±max(0.01, 20 %) band: against exact DFAX at 317–332 PCR buses the gated facility bars pass that band 0.95 / 0.85 / 1.00 (pcr2030 / 2035 / 2040; constraint-level error p95 0.003–0.042, max 0.17 $/MWh). sf is the coefficient on the stored shadow price: its sign follows the store's convention (settled stored negative, PROBE positive), so only |sf| is physical — never colour by it.
method.stacking: stackable = exact or recovered. Bars are signed attributions that never overlap: premiums stack above zero and discounts below (Σ|bars| may exceed |net_mcc| — counter-flow is real physics), ◆ marks net_mcc, and Other (signed, hatched) = net_mcc − Σ bars holds the intercept and every rare, collinear, sub-floor or |SF| > 1 facility. Σ bars + other = net_mcc to 0.0001 (rounded values).

body.names_note: Settled constraint names (ISO-NE, e.g. BERLIN1771ALN) and run constraint names (PSS/E bus pairs) share no key: the unit ($/MWh, settled sign) is one across the divider, constraint identity is not.

body.sign: Every congestion figure is on ISO-NE's settlement convention, LMP = energy + congestion + loss: a negative congestion component prices the node below the system energy price (a generation pocket), a positive one is a premium over it. Settled rows are published as stored. Every PROBE run (5yr, 10yr, pcr2030/2035/2040) stores LMP = energy - congestion + loss, so its congestion is negated at read and its energy recomputed as LMP - congestion - loss; the PCR table's stored energy column (built the other way) is not read.
